Harrison County 100 WEST MARKET STREET, CADIZ, OHIO 43907 740 - 942 - 8867, 740 - 942 - 3034(fax) engineer @harrisoncountyohio.org Special Hauling Permit All heavy equipment operations using county roads must obtain an approved “Special Hauling Permit” before starting any hauling. There is $160.00 charge for the permit. The appropriate Township Trustees must also be contacted before hauling on township ro ads. Township Trustee lists are available at the County Engineer’s Office. During the period of high soil moisture and potential freeze/thaw cycles, the legal load limits on all county and township roads are reduced 50 %. The load reduction period, set b y the Harrison County Commissioners, is between November 15 and April 15. This period is locally referred to as the “Frost Law Period”.
